✨ Product Description

Experience elegance and comfort with our Classic White Panjabi, designed to make every occasion special.

🧵 Material & Quality

100% Premium Cotton 🌿

Lightweight & breathable (140 GSM)

Skin-friendly, soft touch 🤍

👔 Fit & Style

Modern Slim Fit ✨

Side Pockets for convenience 🎉

Perfect for festive & casual wear 🎊

🧼 Care Instructions

Hand wash in cold water 💧

Avoid bleach 🚫

Dry in shade 🌤️

⭐ Why You’ll Love It

✔️ Elegant look for any event
✔️ Durable stitching with attention to detail 🪡
✔️ Made for comfort in every season 🌸☀️🍂❄️
